items.description: As the war in Ukraine took centre stage at the G7 summit in Evian, France, US President Donald Trump said Moscow should make peace with Kyiv and suggested that the US could bring back sanctions on Russian oil now that the Strait of Hormuz is expected to reopen. items.title: Israel-Lebanon talks said close to yielding lasting ceasefire deal
items.description: Details reportedly being finalized; Iran threatens response if IDF keeps fighting Hezbollah, while Israeli and US officials say US-Iran deal doesn't include pullout from south Lebanon The post Israel-Lebanon talks said close to yielding lasting ceasefire deal appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: Russian artist and Putin critic shot dead in Poland
items.description: Robert Kuzovkov, who used the pseudonym Semyon Skrepetsky, has been known for his caricatures of politicians including Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Is the Iran war weakening the US' superpower status?
items.description: The US is still unrivaled in its ability to project military strength around the world, but Iran's success in blocking the Strait of Hormuz has raised tough question on America's role as protector of global trade.

items.title: Resettlement remains out of reach for millions of refugees
items.description: As millions of people continue to flee their countries due to war or persecution, UNHCR, the UN refugee agency, called on Tuesday for an urgent expansion of refugee resettlement programmes, warning that available places continue to fall short of global needs.

items.title: U.K. Sanctions Russia’s New Arctic LNG Fleet in War Economy Crackdown
items.description: The four targeted LNG ships were included in a broader sanctions package hitting 70 individuals and entities.

items.title: Strike on Kyiv Lavra Is Like Bombing Notre-Dame, French FM Says
items.description: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot compared Russia’s strike on Kyiv’s historic Pechersk Lavra to bombing Notre-Dame or Saint-Denis, calling it part of Vladimir Putin’s colonial war against Ukraine. items.title: US-Iran ceasefire leaves Israelis feeling sidelined, their war aims unachieved
items.description: The U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal leaves many Israelis feeling vulnerable and abandoned by their most important ally. They voiced concern for Israel’s security, and some criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for failing to achieve his war aims.

items.title: Drone strikes one of Ukraine's key Christian and cultural sites
items.description: Russian strikes have left cultural scars across Ukraine, damaging Kharkiv's Art Museum and striking Kyiv's historic Pechersk Lavra monastery, reminding how war reaches even sacred and storied places.

items.title: 1,000 Years Of War And Renewal: Kyiv's Monastery Of The Caves
items.description: A blaze on June 15 amid Russia's all-out invasion of Ukraine is the latest war wound inflicted on Kyiv's centuries-old Pechersk Lavra, the most iconic religious landmark in the Ukrainian capital.
